# Town officials and staff -- what was read, and what a row means

**Generated by `scripts/build_town_rosters.py`. Do not edit.**

One row of `town-roster-entries.csv` is one name the annual town report printed
under one heading in one edition. It is not proof the person served the whole
year or that a seat was filled: vacancies are not rows, and the report does not
date its list within the year. Names are printed by the town and kept (see
`notes/process/DATA-PRIVACY.md`).

## The check: line accounting

A list of officers prints no total, so nothing reconciles. Every non-blank line
of every page is claimed as an entry, a heading, or a line that is not a town
official, and the build refuses to write if a page leaves one unclaimed. Every
entry's name is also checked against the printed line it was attributed to.

**17173 of 17173 lines accounted for** across 339 pages of 67 editions; 16609 entries.

Lines claimed as not an entry, by reason: continuation 283, not-a-town-office 489, page-furniture 429, prose-or-schedule 2234, vacancy 305.

`kind` is ours, derived by rule (APPOINT -> appointed, ELECT -> elected, a page registered as a department list -> department roster, else not stated): appointed 9968, department roster 3318, elected 3113, not stated 210.

**184 rows carry `kind_flag = minority`**: their elected/appointed kind disagrees with what the same position is in at least 80% of its other rows. Most are the 1993 and 1994 directories, which run the two lists side by side in shared columns. The 1991 report prints its ELECTED and APPOINTED headings swapped (p4 lines 2 and 32); `section` keeps the print and `kind` is swapped for that edition.

## How the pages were read

Pages were located by reading each edition (`town-rosters/PAGES.csv`), dumped
with each printed run's left edge (`@NN`) because the directory is printed in
columns, and read one page at a time by a language model in an isolated call
(`read_town_roster_pages.py`), which places each name under the heading above it.
An entry whose name sat on the line directly above or below the one it was given
was moved there by that evidence: 3 such moves, listed below.

Model cost recorded on the pages: $29.10 API-equivalent.

## Lists looked for and not found

Each is a statement about what was searched, not a claim the town never
printed it (rule 13c).

| edition | list | pages and searches |
|---|---|---|
| 2008 | elected officials | The 2008 report prints the FY'2008 APPOINTMENT LIST (pp7-9) and no elected-officials list. Pages 1-12 read (p5 About the Town, p6 meeting schedule, p10 onward department reports); the whole text searched for the elected boards' headings (MODERATOR, BOARD OF SELECTMEN, SCHOOL COMMITTEE, LIBRARY TRUSTEES, BOARD OF ASSESSORS, TOWN CLERK) and for ELECTED OFFICIALS / TERM EXPIRES: only department-report and election-result headings found. |
